ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Mercury and Venus

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your money and what you value.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. It is a good day to start something in this area.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on your money and what you value. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on your image and your personal energy. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on rest and your inner life. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your career and your goals.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on friends and plans for the future. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on your career and your goals. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on relationships and partnerships. A new beginning may be born from here.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on routine, daily work and health. This is where your strength lies today.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up home and family.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Until {H:1814424953000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:2}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on home and family. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.
